transcript:
DAVID: Martin... Pick up, man. I'm here. Waitin' on you. C'mon, man, pick up.

DAVID: Hey! You better be there! 

DAVID: Where the hell are you?... 

DAVID: Well I can wait... I just came to the middle of nowhere for you. This is ridiculous.

DAVID: You on the crapper or something? Pick up!

DAVID: You better not be out... You think you can escape? Not that easy my friend...

DAVID: I'm gonna be pretty freakin' pissed if I drove all the way out here for you to flake on this, man.

DAVID: Martin!
